name: memory_list
description: List memories with safe cursor pagination, time bounds, and tier filtering without scoring.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor token for pagination from previous memory_list response.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default 50, max 500).

created_from.description: Lower timestamp bound in epoch milliseconds (inclusive).

created_to.description: Upper timestamp bound in epoch milliseconds (inclusive).

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
